_comment: Copy this file to 'hapticai.local.json' (same folder) and set your backend URL. hapticai.local.json is gitignored so it never gets committed. Leave hapticServiceUrl empty to run the scene fully on-device (offline mock synth, no server). The Gemini API key is NO LONGER set here — prompt generation runs on the backend, which reads GEMINI_API_KEY from its own environment.
